question:
Aadhaar is a 12-digit unique number that is issued by the ______________.

[RRB NTPC CBT]
options: Unique Identification Authority of India
Unique Indian Digital Authority of India
Unique Indian Demographic Association of India
Unique Identification Association of India
solution:
Solution: Correct Answer is Unique Identification Authority of India

Explanation:
Aadhaar is a 12-digit unique identification number issued by the Unique Identification Authority of India (UIDAI). UIDAI was established in 2009 by the Government of India and operates under the Planning Commission (now NITI Aayog). The purpose of Aadhaar is to provide a universal identity to residents of India, which can be used to access various government and private services. It is based on demographic and biometric data and can be obtained by every resident of India.

Extra Facts:
Aadhaar is considered the world's largest biometric ID system. It is used for services like Direct Benefit Transfer (DBT), opening bank accounts, obtaining SIM cards, and tax payments. In 2016, it was given statutory status under the Aadhaar Act. To keep Aadhaar data secure and private, UIDAI has introduced features like masking and Virtual ID.

Important Points:
☛ UIDAI - 2009 (Unique Identification Authority of India)
☛ Aadhaar Act - 2016 (Statutory status to Aadhaar)
☛ DBT - Direct Benefit Transfer (Linked to Aadhaar)
☛ Biometric Data - Fingerprint and Iris Scan
☛ Virtual ID - Security measure for Aadhaar
question_hi:
आधार एक 12-अंकीय अद्वितीय संख्या है जो _______ द्वारा जारी की जाती है।

[RRB NTPC CBT]
options_hi: भारतीय विशिष्ट पहचान प्राधिकरण
भारतीय विशिष्ट भारत प्राधिकरण
भारत का विशिष्ट भारतीय जनसांख्यिकीय संघ
भारतीय विशिष्ट पहचान संघ
solution_hi:
हल: सही उत्तर है भारतीय विशिष्ट पहचान प्राधिकरण

Explanation:
आधार एक 12-अंकीय अद्वितीय पहचान संख्या है जो भारतीय विशिष्ट पहचान प्राधिकरण (UIDAI) द्वारा जारी की जाती है। UIDAI की स्थापना 2009 में भारत सरकार द्वारा की गई थी और यह योजना आयोग (अब नीति आयोग) के अधीन काम करता है। आधार का उद्देश्य भारत के निवासियों को एक सार्वभौमिक पहचान प्रदान करना है, जिसका उपयोग विभिन्न सरकारी और निजी सेवाओं तक पहुँचने के लिए किया जा सकता है। यह जनसांख्यिकीय और बायोमेट्रिक डेटा पर आधारित है और इसे भारत का हर निवासी प्राप्त कर सकता है।

Extra Facts:
आधार को विश्व का सबसे बड़ा बायोमेट्रिक आईडी सिस्टम माना जाता है। इसका उपयोग सब्सिडी का सीधा लाभ (DBT), बैंक खाता खोलने, सिम कार्ड प्राप्त करने और कर भुगतान जैसी सेवाओं के लिए किया जाता है। 2016 में, इसे आधार अधिनियम के तहत वैधानिक दर्जा दिया गया। आधार डेटा को सुरक्षित और निजी रखने के लिए UIDAI ने मास्किंग और वर्चुअल आईडी जैसी सुविधाएँ भी शुरू की हैं।

Important Points:
☛ UIDAI - 2009 (भारतीय विशिष्ट पहचान प्राधिकरण)
☛ आधार अधिनियम - 2016 (आधार को वैधानिक दर्जा)
☛ DBT - सीधा लाभ हस्तांतरण (आधार से जुड़ा)
☛ बायोमेट्रिक डेटा - फिंगरप्रिंट और आइरिस स्कैन
☛ वर्चुअल आईडी - आधार की सुरक्षा के लिए उपाय

question:
AMRUT scheme was launched under the sanitation programme in 2015. What is the full form of AMRUT?

[SSC CGL 2020]
options: Atal Mission for Rejuvenation and Urban Transformation
Amar Mission for Renewable and Ultra Transmission
Aqua Mission for Renewable and Ultra Transformation
Aqua Mission for Rejuvenation and Urban Transmission
solution:
Solution: Correct Answer is Atal Mission for Rejuvenation and Urban Transformation

Explanation:
The full form of AMRUT is Atal Mission for Rejuvenation and Urban Transformation. This scheme was launched in 2015 by the Ministry of Urban Development. Its primary objective is to improve urban infrastructure, including water supply, sewage management, and urban transport. It works in tandem with the Smart Cities Mission. The scheme is named after former Prime Minister Atal Bihari Vajpayee.

Extra Facts:
AMRUT primarily focuses on covering over 500 cities. The scheme promotes water conservation, park development, and public transport. A budget of approximately ₹2 lakh crore has been allocated for this mission. It also supports the Sustainable Development Goals (SDGs).

Important Points:
☛ Smart Cities Mission - 2015 (Promoting urban development)
☛ Pradhan Mantri Awas Yojana (PMAY) - 2015 (Housing for all)
☛ Swachh Bharat Mission - 2014 (Urban and rural sanitation)
☛ HRIDAY Scheme - 2016 (Development of urban roads)
☛ Jal Jeevan Mission - 2019 (Providing drinking water in rural areas)
question_hi:
अमृत योजना 2015 में स्वच्छता कार्यक्रम के तहत शुरू की गई थी। AMRUTका पूर्ण रूप क्या है?

[SSC CGL 2020]
options_hi: Atal Mission for Rejuvenation and Urban Transformation
Amar Mission for Renewable and Ultra Transmission
Aqua Mission for Renewable and Ultra Transformation
Aqua Mission for Rejuvenation and Urban Transmission
solution_hi:
हल: सही उत्तर है Atal Mission for Rejuvenation and Urban Transformation

Explanation:
अमृत योजना (AMRUT) का पूरा नाम Atal Mission for Rejuvenation and Urban Transformation है। यह योजना 2015 में शहरी विकास मंत्रालय द्वारा शुरू की गई थी। इसका मुख्य उद्देश्य शहरी क्षेत्रों में बुनियादी ढांचे को सुधारना, जल आपूर्ति, सीवेज प्रबंधन और शहरी परिवहन जैसी सुविधाओं को बेहतर बनाना है। यह योजना 'स्मार्ट सिटी मिशन' के साथ मिलकर काम करती है। इसका नाम पूर्व प्रधानमंत्री अटल बिहारी वाजपेयी के नाम पर रखा गया है।

Extra Facts:
अमृत योजना का मुख्य फोकस 500 से अधिक शहरों को कवर करना है। यह योजना जल संरक्षण, पार्कों का विकास और सार्वजनिक परिवहन को बढ़ावा देती है। इसके तहत लगभग 2 लाख करोड़ रुपये का बजट आवंटित किया गया है। यह योजना सतत विकास लक्ष्यों (SDGs) को भी सपोर्ट करती है।

Important Points:
☛ स्मार्ट सिटी मिशन - 2015 (शहरी विकास को बढ़ावा देना)
☛ प्रधानमंत्री आवास योजना (PMAY) - 2015 (सभी को आवास उपलब्ध कराना)
☛ स्वच्छ भारत मिशन - 2014 (शहरी और ग्रामीण स्वच्छता)
☛ हृदय योजना - 2016 (शहरी सड़कों का विकास)
☛ जल जीवन मिशन - 2019 (ग्रामीण क्षेत्रों में पेयजल उपलब्ध कराना)

question:
In which of the following years was the Fit India Movement launched by Ministry of Youth Affairs and Sports, GoI?

[SSC CGL 2022]
options: 2018
2001
2020
2019
solution:
Solution: Correct Answer is 2019

Explanation:
The Fit India Movement was launched on 29th August 2019 by Prime Minister Narendra Modi. It is an initiative by the Ministry of Youth Affairs and Sports, Government of India, aimed at encouraging Indians to adopt a physically active and healthy lifestyle. The main focus of this campaign is to make fitness an integral part of daily life. It was launched on the occasion of National Sports Day (29th August), which is celebrated to honor the birth anniversary of hockey legend Major Dhyan Chand.

Extra Facts:
Under the Fit India Movement, various activities like yoga, cycling, running, and other sports are promoted. The target was to connect 100 million people with fitness by 2022. This campaign organizes programs in schools, colleges, workplaces, and communities to promote fitness. The Prime Minister gave the slogan 'Fit India, Hit India' for this movement.

Important Points:
☛ National Sports Day - 29th August (Birth anniversary of Major Dhyan Chand)
☛ Fit India Dialogue - 2019 (Organized for discussions on fitness)
☛ Fit India Freedom Run - 2021 (Under Azadi Ka Amrit Mahotsav)
☛ Khelo India Scheme - 2018 (To promote sports)
☛ Ministry of Youth Affairs and Sports - Minister Anurag Thakur (as of 2023)
question_hi:
युवा मामले और खेल मंत्रालय, भारत सरकार द्वारा फिट इंडिया मूवमेंट निम्नलिखित में से किस वर्ष शुरू किया गया था?

[SSC CGL 2022]
options_hi: 2018
2001
2020
2019
solution_hi:
हल: सही उत्तर है 2019

Explanation:
फिट इंडिया मूवमेंट को 29 अगस्त 2019 को प्रधानमंत्री नरेंद्र मोदी द्वारा लॉन्च किया गया था। यह युवा मामले और खेल मंत्रालय, भारत सरकार की एक पहल है जिसका उद्देश्य भारतीय नागरिकों को शारीरिक रूप से सक्रिय और स्वस्थ जीवनशैली अपनाने के लिए प्रेरित करना है। इस अभियान का मुख्य फोकस फिटनेस को दैनिक जीवन का हिस्सा बनाना है। इसे राष्ट्रीय खेल दिवस (29 अगस्त) के अवसर पर शुरू किया गया था, जो हॉकी के महान खिलाड़ी मेजर ध्यानचंद की जयंती के रूप में मनाया जाता है।

Extra Facts:
फिट इंडिया मूवमेंट के तहत विभिन्न गतिविधियाँ जैसे योग, साइकिलिंग, दौड़ना, और अन्य खेलों को बढ़ावा दिया जाता है। इसका लक्ष्य 2022 तक 100 मिलियन लोगों को फिटनेस से जोड़ना था। यह अभियान स्कूलों, कॉलेजों, कार्यस्थलों और समुदायों में फिटनेस को बढ़ावा देने के लिए कार्यक्रम आयोजित करता है। प्रधानमंत्री ने इस अभियान को 'फिट इंडिया, हिट इंडिया' का नारा दिया है।

Important Points:
☛ राष्ट्रीय खेल दिवस - 29 अगस्त (मेजर ध्यानचंद की जयंती)
☛ फिट इंडिया डायलॉग - 2019 (फिटनेस पर चर्चा के लिए आयोजित)
☛ फिट इंडिया फ्रीडम रन - 2021 (आजादी का अमृत महोत्सव के तहत)
☛ Khelo India योजना - 2018 (खेलों को बढ़ावा देने के लिए)
☛ युवा मामले और खेल मंत्रालय - राज्यमंत्री अनुराग ठाकुर (2023 में)

question:
Who among the following launched the digital platform 'FASTER' ?

[SSC CHSL 2024]
options: Finance Minister
President
Chief Justice of India
Prime Minister
solution:
Solution: Correct Answer is Chief Justice of India

Explanation:
The digital platform 'FASTER' (Fast and Secure Transmission of Electronic Records) was launched on 13 August 2021 by the then Chief Justice of India (CJI) N.V. Ramana. It is designed for the quick and secure transmission of court orders, judgments, and other legal documents between the Supreme Court and High Courts across India. The platform aims to make judicial processes digital and paperless, enhancing the efficiency and transparency of the justice delivery system.

Extra Facts:
FASTER is part of the e-Courts Mission Mode Project, initiated to digitally empower India's judiciary. It adheres to cybersecurity protocols and grants access only to authorized users. The platform is expected to reduce case pendency by saving time spent on physical document transfers.

Important Points:
☛ e-Courts Project - 2005 (Digitization of courts)
☛ Supreme Court App - 2020 (Case status tracking for citizens)
☛ National Judicial Data Grid (NJDG) - National database of court case data
☛ Ministry of Law & Justice - Nodal agency for judicial reforms
☛ CJI N.V. Ramana - 48th CJI (2021-2022)
question_hi:
निम्नलिखित में से किसने डिजिटल प्लेटफॉर्म 'FASTER' लॉन्च किया ?

[SSC CHSL 2024]
options_hi: वित्त मंत्री
राष्ट्रपति
भारत के मुख्य न्यायाधीश
प्रधान मंत्री
solution_hi:
हल: सही उत्तर है भारत के मुख्य न्यायाधीश

Explanation:
'FASTER' (Fast and Secure Transmission of Electronic Records) डिजिटल प्लेटफॉर्म को 13 अगस्त, 2021 को भारत के तत्कालीन मुख्य न्यायाधीश एन.वी. रमना द्वारा लॉन्च किया गया था। यह प्लेटफॉर्म सुप्रीम कोर्ट और देश भर के हाई कोर्ट्स के बीच आदेशों, निर्णयों और अन्य कानूनी दस्तावेजों के त्वरित और सुरक्षित संचरण के लिए बनाया गया है। इसका उद्देश्य न्यायिक प्रक्रिया को डिजिटल और पेपरलेस बनाना है, जिससे न्याय प्रणाली की दक्षता और पारदर्शिता बढ़ेगी।

Extra Facts:
FASTER सिस्टम ई-कोर्ट्स मिशन मोड प्रोजेक्ट का हिस्सा है, जिसे भारत की न्यायपालिका को डिजिटल रूप से सशक्त बनाने के लिए शुरू किया गया है। यह साइबर सुरक्षा मानकों का पालन करता है और केवल अधिकृत उपयोगकर्ताओं तक पहुंच प्रदान करता है। इस प्लेटफॉर्म से मुकदमों की अवधि कम होने की उम्मीद है, क्योंकि दस्तावेजों के भौतिक प्रसारण में लगने वाला समय बचेगा।

Important Points:
☛ ई-कोर्ट्स प्रोजेक्ट - 2005 (न्यायालयों का डिजिटलीकरण)
☛ सुप्रीम कोर्ट ऐप - 2020 (नागरिकों के लिए केस स्टेटस ट्रैकिंग)
☛ नेशनल ज्यूडिशियल डेटा ग्रिड (NJDG) - कोर्ट केस डेटा का राष्ट्रीय डेटाबेस
☛ विधि मंत्रालय - न्यायिक सुधारों के लिए नोडल एजेंसी
☛ मुख्य न्यायाधीश एन.वी. रमना - 48वें CJI (2021-2022)

question:
In Pradhan Mantri Gramin Awaas yojana, the cost of unit assistance is shared between Central and State Governments in the ratio _____ in plain areas.

[SSC CGL 2024]
options: 60 : 40
40 : 60
90 : 10
30 : 70
solution:
Solution: Correct Answer is 60 : 40

Explanation:
Under the Pradhan Mantri Gramin Awaas Yojana (PMGAY), the cost of unit assistance in plain areas is shared between the Central and State Governments in a 60:40 ratio. This ratio reflects the central government’s higher financial contribution to address rural housing shortages. For hilly and difficult terrains, the ratio is 90:10 due to higher construction costs in these regions.

Extra Facts:
PMGAY was launched in 2016 as part of the Pradhan Mantri Awas Yojana-Gramin (PMAY-G), aiming to provide "Housing for All" by 2022. It targets homeless families and those living in kutcha houses. Beneficiaries are selected based on the Socio-Economic Caste Census (SECC) 2011 data.

Important Points:
☛ PMAY-G - 2016 (Rural housing scheme)
☛ SECC 2011 (Beneficiary selection criteria)
☛ Hilly/Difficult areas ratio - 90:10
☛ Urban housing scheme - PMAY-U (2015)
☛ Per unit assistance - ₹1.20 lakh (plains), ₹1.30 lakh (hilly)
question_hi:
प्रधानमंत्री ग्रामीण आवास योजना में, मैदानी क्षेत्रों के लिए इकाई सहायता की लागत केंद्र और राज्य सरकारों के बीच ______के अनुपात में साझा की जाती है।

[SSC CGL 2024]
options_hi: 60 : 40
40 : 60
90 : 10
30 : 70
solution_hi:
हल: सही उत्तर है 60 : 40

Explanation:
प्रधानमंत्री ग्रामीण आवास योजना (PMGAY) के तहत, मैदानी क्षेत्रों में इकाई सहायता की लागत केंद्र और राज्य सरकारों के बीच 60:40 के अनुपात में साझा की जाती है। यह अनुपात केंद्र सरकार द्वारा अधिकांश वित्तीय भार उठाने को दर्शाता है, जिससे ग्रामीण क्षेत्रों में आवास की कमी को दूर करने में मदद मिलती है। पहाड़ी और दुर्गम क्षेत्रों के लिए यह अनुपात 90:10 होता है, क्योंकि इन क्षेत्रों में निर्माण लागत अधिक होती है।

Extra Facts:
PMGAY को 2016 में प्रधानमंत्री आवास योजना-ग्रामीण (PMAY-G) के रूप में लॉन्च किया गया था। इसका उद्देश्य 2022 तक "सभी के लिए आवास" प्रदान करना था। यह योजना बेघरों और कच्चे घरों में रहने वाले परिवारों को लाभान्वित करती है। लाभार्थियों का चयन सामाजिक-आर्थिक जनगणना (SECC) 2011 के आधार पर किया जाता है।

Important Points:
☛ PMAY-G - 2016 (ग्रामीण आवास योजना)
☛ SECC 2011 (लाभार्थी चयन का आधार)
☛ पहाड़ी/दुर्गम क्षेत्रों में अनुपात - 90:10
☛ शहरी आवास योजना - PMAY-U (2015)
☛ प्रति इकाई सहायता - ₹1.20 लाख (मैदानी), ₹1.30 लाख (पहाड़ी)

question:
‘Swasthya Sathi’ scheme is the health insurance scheme that covers the entire population of which of the following states?

[SSC CGL 2020]
options: Assam
West Bengal
Meghalaya
Bihar
solution:
Solution: Correct Answer is West Bengal

Explanation:

question:

The National Youth Policy (NYP) 2014 was launched by the Government of India on 15th February 2014. The policy aims to support youth in areas such as education, employment, health, and leadership. It was formulated with the vision of 'Empowered Youth, Empowered India' and is an updated version of the earlier 2003 policy.

question:

[SSC CHSL 2022]

solution:

Explanation:
MGNREGA was implemented in 2005 and is a crucial scheme to ensure employment in rural areas. Under this scheme, each family is guaranteed 100 days of employment per year. This scheme was launched to provide employment to unskilled laborers and strengthen the rural economy. Its main focus is poverty alleviation and providing social security.

Extra Facts:
MGNREGA is considered the world's largest social security program. This scheme is implemented by the Ministry of Rural Development. Under this, employment must be provided within 15 days to the person demanding work, otherwise, an unemployment allowance is given. question:
Which state initiated the implementation of the Mid-day Meal scheme in elementary schools?

[SSC CGL 2024]
options: Tamil Nadu
Madhya Pradesh
Uttar Pradesh
Karnataka
solution:
Solution: Correct Answer is Tamil Nadu

Explanation:
Tamil Nadu pioneered the Mid-day Meal Scheme in 1956, initially called the 'School Lunch Programme'. It was India's first state-level initiative aimed at increasing school enrollment and attendance. Later, this scheme was expanded nationwide in 1995 as the National Mid-day Meal Scheme (MDMS). Tamil Nadu's initiative set a benchmark for nutrition and education programs across the country.

Extra Facts:
The Mid-day Meal Scheme is the world's largest school feeding program, serving meals to approximately 12 crore children daily. Its primary objectives are improving children's nutritional status and enhancing access to education. The scheme is mandatory under the Right to Education Act, 2009.

Important Points:
☛ National Mid-day Meal Scheme (MDMS) - 1995 (Centrally sponsored scheme)

question_hi:

question:
Which one of the following was the first Indian state to achieve 100% sanitation in rural and urban households, schools, sanitary complexes and Aanganwadi centers in 2014 ?

[CONSTABLE EXECUTIVE ]
options: Kerala
Nagaland
Sikkim
Chhattisgarh
solution:
Solution: Correct Answer is Sikkim

Explanation:
Sikkim was the first Indian state to achieve 100% sanitation in rural and urban households, schools, sanitary complexes, and Aanganwadi centers in 2014. This milestone was achieved under the 'Nirmal Sikkim' campaign. The state government promoted sanitation drives, awareness programs, and community participation to accomplish this feat. It included the construction of toilets in homes, schools, Anganwadi centers, and public complexes. This achievement came even before the Swachh Bharat Mission, making Sikkim a model state.

Extra Facts:
Sikkim is not only a leader in sanitation but also India’s first organic state (declared in 2016). The state has implemented measures like plastic bans, afforestation, and tourism promotion. The Nirmal Sikkim campaign set an example for other states, inspiring the central government to launch the Swachh Bharat Mission in 2014.

Important Points:
☛ Nirmal Sikkim - 2008 (Sanitation Campaign)
☛ Swachh Bharat Mission - 2014 (Central Govt. Scheme)
☛ Organic Sikkim - 2016 (100% Organic Farming)
☛ Kerala - Declared ODF (Open Defecation Free) in 2016
☛ Himachal Pradesh - First ODF State (2008, Nirmal Gram Puraskar)

question:

[SSC MTS 2023]
options: 25 to 60 years

solution:

Explanation:
The Deen Dayal Upadhyaya Grameen Kaushalya Yojana (DDU-GKY) is a flagship scheme of the Government of India aimed at providing employment-linked skill training to rural youth. Under this scheme, the age group 15 to 35 years is covered. It specifically targets youth from Below Poverty Line (BPL) and Scheduled Caste/Tribe (SC/ST) backgrounds. This scheme is part of the National Rural Livelihood Mission (NRLM) and is implemented by the Ministry of Rural Development.

Extra Facts:

question:

Extra Facts:
The NTP was later upgraded in 1997 as the Revised National TB Control Programme (RNTCP), which included the DOTS (Directly Observed Treatment, Short-course) strategy. This is an effective treatment method recommended by the World Health Organization (WHO).

question:
What is MPLADS?

[RRB NTPC CBT]
options: A scheme launched by the government of India which enables Members of Parliament to do development work in their constituencies.
A scheme launched by the Madhya Pradesh government for the protection of ladies
A scheme launched by Maharashtra and Punjab government for legal assistance to deprived sections
A scheme launched by Madhya Pradesh government for the protection of lions and other endangered species
solution:
Solution: Correct Answer is A scheme launched by the government of India which enables Members of Parliament to do development work in their constituencies.

Explanation:
MPLADS (Members of Parliament Local Area Development Scheme) is a scheme launched by the Government of India in 1993. Under this scheme, each Member of Parliament (MP) is allocated ₹5 crore annually to undertake development projects in their respective constituencies. The objective is to promote local-level infrastructure development, including education, health, water supply, etc. The scheme is applicable in both rural and urban areas and is administered by the Ministry of Statistics and Programme Implementation (MoSPI).

Extra Facts:
The MPLADS fund can be used for public utility works such as schools, hospitals, roads, bridges, water tanks, etc. However, the fund cannot be used for religious or political purposes. In 2020, during the COVID-19 pandemic, MPLADS funds were also utilized for relief work.

question:
Under which ministry was the National Mission for Manuscript established in February 2003?

[RRB NTPC CBT]
options: Ministry of Culture
Ministry of Finance
Ministry of Human Resource Development
Ministry of Tourism
solution:
Solution: Correct Answer is Ministry of Culture

Explanation:
The National Mission for Manuscripts (NMM) was established in February 2003 under the Ministry of Culture, Government of India. The primary objective of this mission is to preserve, document, and make India's manuscripts publicly accessible. This mission operates in collaboration with the Indira Gandhi National Centre for the Arts (IGNCA). The NMM has undertaken several significant initiatives to digitize and conserve manuscripts.

Extra Facts:
The National Mission for Manuscripts has discovered and conserved millions of manuscripts so far. It promotes the preservation and research of manuscripts through projects like 'Kriti Raksha' and 'Tattvabodh'. Additionally, the mission studies manuscripts written in various languages and scripts.

question:
Under which of the following schemes, do the designated states procure, store and issue food grains under the Targeted public Distribution system?

[NTPC CBT 2]
options: Centralised Procurement Scheme
Decentralised Procurement Scheme
Minimum Support Price
Price Stabilization Fund
solution:
Solution: Correct Answer is Decentralised Procurement Scheme

Explanation:
Under the Decentralised Procurement Scheme (DCP), state governments directly procure food grains from farmers and distribute them through the Targeted Public Distribution System (TPDS). This scheme was launched in 1997-98 to reduce dependence on central agencies, minimize storage and transportation costs, and improve efficiency. States are responsible for procurement, storage, and distribution as per guidelines set by the central government.

Extra Facts:
The DCP scheme primarily focuses on the procurement of rice and wheat. States must procure at the Minimum Support Price (MSP) fixed by the central government. This scheme facilitates the distribution of subsidized food grains under the National Food Security Act (NFSA), 2013. Currently, over 10 states are benefiting from this scheme.

Important Points:
☛ Centralised Procurement Scheme - Managed by FCI (Central Govt. agency)
☛ Minimum Support Price (MSP) - Ensures fixed prices for farmers

☛ TPDS - Distributes subsidized food grains to the poor
☛ NFSA 2013 - Provides food security to two-thirds of the population
question_hi:

solution_hi:
हल: सही उत्तर है विकेंद्रीकृत खरीद योजना

Explanation:
विकेंद्रीकृत खरीद योजना (DCP) के तहत, राज्य सरकारें सीधे किसानों से खाद्यान्न की खरीद करती हैं और इसे लक्षित सार्वजनिक वितरण प्रणाली (TPDS) के माध्यम से वितरित करती हैं। यह योजना 1997-98 में शुरू की गई थी और इसका उद्देश्य केंद्रीय एजेंसियों पर निर्भरता कम करना, भंडारण और परिवहन लागत को कम करना तथा दक्षता बढ़ाना है। इस योजना में, राज्यों को केंद्र सरकार द्वारा निर्धारित मानदंडों के अनुसार खरीद, भंडारण और वितरण की जिम्मेदारी दी जाती है।

Extra Facts:
DCP योजना मुख्य रूप से चावल और गेहूं की खरीद पर केंद्रित है। इसमें राज्यों को केंद्र सरकार द्वारा निर्धारित न्यूनतम समर्थन मूल्य (MSP) पर खरीद करनी होती है। यह योजना राष्ट्रीय खाद्य सुरक्षा अधिनियम (NFSA), 2013 के तहत सब्सिडी वाले खाद्यान्न के वितरण को सुविधाजनक बनाती है। वर्तमान में, 10 से अधिक राज्य इस योजना का लाभ उठा रहे हैं।

question:
In MUDRA Yojana, what does 'M' stand for?

[SSC MTS 2022]
options: Macro
Money
Micro
Multi
solution:
Solution: Correct Answer is Micro

Explanation:
The full form of MUDRA Yojana is 'Micro Units Development and Refinance Agency', where 'M' stands for 'Micro'. This scheme was launched by the Government of India to provide financial assistance to small and micro enterprises (MSMEs). The primary objective is to offer loan facilities to non-corporate small businesses, promoting employment generation and economic growth. MUDRA Yojana was launched in 2015 and provides loans under three categories: Shishu, Kishor, and Tarun.

Extra Facts:
Under MUDRA Yojana, loans are categorized into three types: Shishu (up to 50,000 INR), Kishor (50,000 to 5 lakh INR), and Tarun (5 lakh to 10 lakh INR). This scheme benefits small entrepreneurs who struggle to secure traditional bank loans. The Pradhan Mantri MUDRA Yojana (PMMY) is a part of MUDRA, offering collateral-free loans to beneficiaries. This scheme plays a crucial role in promoting financial inclusion.

Important Points:
☛ MUDRA Yojana - 2015 (Loan facility for small enterprises)
☛ PMMY - Pradhan Mantri MUDRA Yojana (Loan distribution under MUDRA)
☛ Shishu, Kishor, Tarun - Three categories of MUDRA loans
☛ MSMEs - Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises (Beneficiaries)
☛ Financial Inclusion - Key objective of MUDRA
question_hi:
“MUDRA योजना" में, 'M' का क्या अर्थ है?

[SSC MTS 2022]

Explanation:
MUDRA योजना का पूरा नाम 'Micro Units Development and Refinance Agency' है। यहाँ 'M' का अर्थ 'Micro' है। यह योजना भारत सरकार द्वारा छोटे और सूक्ष्म उद्यमों (Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises - MSMEs) को वित्तीय सहायता प्रदान करने के लिए शुरू की गई थी। इसका मुख्य उद्देश्य गैर-कॉर्पोरेट छोटे व्यवसायों को ऋण सुविधा प्रदान करना है, जिससे रोजगार सृजन और आर्थिक विकास को बढ़ावा मिल सके। MUDRA योजना को 2015 में लॉन्च किया गया था और यह तीन श्रेणियों - शिशु, किशोर और तरुण के तहत ऋण प्रदान करती है।

Extra Facts:
MUDRA योजना के तहत, ऋण की तीन श्रेणियाँ हैं: शिशु (50,000 रुपये तक), किशोर (50,000 से 5 लाख रुपये) और तरुण (5 लाख से 10 लाख रुपये)। इस योजना का लाभ उन छोटे व्यवसायियों को मिलता है जो बैंकों से पारंपरिक ऋण प्राप्त करने में असमर्थ होते हैं। MUDRA योजना के तहत प्रधानमंत्री मुद्रा योजना (PMMY) भी शामिल है, जिसके माध्यम से लाभार्थियों को बिना किसी गारंटी के ऋण मिलता है। यह योजना वित्तीय समावेशन को बढ़ावा देने में महत्वपूर्ण भूमिका निभाती है।

question:
Market Based Economic Dispatch (MBED) Mechanism is related with which of the following ministry?

[SSC CHSL 2022]
options: Ministry of Power
Ministry of Corporate Affairs
Ministry of Finance
Ministry of Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises
solution:
Solution: Correct Answer is Ministry of Power

Explanation:
The Market Based Economic Dispatch (MBED) mechanism is a significant initiative proposed by the Ministry of Power, Government of India. It aims to make electricity distribution more efficient and transparent. This mechanism establishes a coordinated market-based system between power producers and distributors, reducing electricity costs and maximizing resource utilization. It aligns with the National Electricity Policy and the Electricity Act, 2003.

Extra Facts:
The primary goal of MBED is to unify electricity prices across the country and promote inter-state electricity trade. It prioritizes generation companies based on their costs, ensuring cheaper electricity for consumers. This will also reduce carbon emissions as low-cost and more efficient plants will be prioritized.

Important Points:
☛ Electricity Act, 2003 (Regulation of the power sector in India)
☛ UDAY Scheme - 2015 (Financial restructuring of power distribution companies)

सूक्ष्म, लघु और मध्यम उद्यम मंत्रालय

question:

Its primary objectives include reducing malnutrition, enhancing access to health services, and ensuring holistic child development. question:
When was the Prime Minister’s Employment Generation Programme (PMEGP) launched ?

[SSC CPO 2024]
options: 2008
2009
2006
2012
solution:
Solution: Correct Answer is 2008

Explanation:
The Prime Minister’s Employment Generation Programme (PMEGP) was launched on 15th August 2008. It is a credit-linked subsidy scheme introduced by the Central Government to promote employment generation and development of micro-enterprises. The scheme is implemented by the Khadi and Village Industries Commission (KVIC) and focuses on creating self-employment opportunities in both rural and urban areas.

Extra Facts:
PMEGP was introduced as an integration of two earlier schemes: Prime Minister’s Rojgar Yojana (PMRY) and Rural Employment Generation Programme (REGP). The program aims to provide financial assistance to unemployed youth and traditional artisans.

question:

Explanation:

This scheme uses a community-based approach to empower women and reduce poverty. Its main objective is to make women economically independent and provide social security. Under Kudumbashree, women are organized into Self-Help Groups (SHGs), which engage in savings, credit, and income-generation activities.

Extra Facts:
Kudumbashree is the largest women's self-help group network in Asia, with over 4.5 million members. This scheme is implemented in both rural and urban areas of Kerala. question:
Under the Ayushman Bharat scheme of the Government of India, how much of the following annual health cover is given to a family ?

4 lakh
3 lakh

Explanation:
The Ayushman Bharat Pradhan Mantri Jan Arogya Yojana (AB-PMJAY) is a flagship health insurance scheme launched by the Government of India in September 2018. Under this scheme, each eligible family is provided with an annual health cover of Rs. 5 lakh. This scheme primarily targets the poor and vulnerable sections of society. Its objective is to enhance access to healthcare services and reduce out-of-pocket expenses. The scheme covers approximately 10.74 crore families across India.

Ayushman Bharat is the world's largest health insurance scheme. It includes secondary and tertiary healthcare services. Beneficiaries under this scheme receive cashless treatment for hospitalization. question_hi:
